legend: Danny always suffers because of his terrible memory. Last time, he forgot the anniversary of his couple, and Dannita got extremely mad at him. Needless to say, he spent a terrible week after that.
This time, Dannita gave him an array A$$$A$$$ as a present for Saint Valentine. Unfortunately, Danny lost it, and he can't remember its elements. He is in big trouble if he doesn't get it back!!
Luckily, Danny remembers a few facts about the array.
First of all, he remembers that it is a permutation of the numbers from 0$$$0$$$ to N−1$$$N-1$$$. That means that it contains every number from 0$$$0$$$ to N−1$$$N-1$$$ exactly once.

Secondly, he remembers that the array has the following property. Let B$$$B$$$ be the array constructed as follows: bi=ai xor 1$$$b_i = a_i \text{ xor } 1$$$ for each 1≤i≤N$$$1 \leq i \leq N$$$, where xor refers to the bitwise xor operation. Let inv(A)$$$inv(A)$$$ be the number of inversions of the array A$$$A$$$ and inv(B)$$$inv(B)$$$ be the number of inversions of the array B$$$B$$$ (the number of inversions is the number of pairs (i,j)$$$(i,j)$$$ such that i<j$$$i \lt j$$$ and ai>aj$$$a_i  \gt  a_j$$$ ). Danny remembers the difference between inv(B)$$$inv(B)$$$ and inv(A)$$$inv(A)$$$. In other words, Danny remembers an integer D$$$D$$$ where D=inv(B)−inv(A)$$$D = inv(B) - inv(A)$$$.
Thirdly, Danny remembers that for all 0≤x≤N−1$$$0 \leq x \leq N-1$$$, x$$$x$$$ and x xor 1$$$x \text{ xor } 1$$$ are NOT adjacent in the array A.
Can you help Danny find the number of possible arrays A that satisfy all these conditions
input: The first and only line of input contains two integers N$$$N$$$ and D$$$D$$$ (1≤N≤105,0≤|D|≤1018$$$1 \leq N \leq 10^5, 0 \leq |D| \leq 10^{18}$$$)
output: A single integer: the number of arrays that satisfy the conditions.
Since it can be very large, print the answer modulo 998244353$$$998244353$$$.

legend.ai: Danny 总是因为糟糕的记忆力而受苦。上次，他忘记了自己和伴侣的纪念日，Dannita 对他非常生气。不用说，那之后的一周他过得十分糟糕。
这一次，Dannita 在圣瓦伦丁节送给他一个数组 A$$$A$$$ 作为礼物。不幸的是，Danny 把它弄丢了，而且记不起其中的元素。如果他不能找回它，那可就麻烦大了！！

其次，他记得该数组具有如下性质。令 B$$$B$$$ 表示按如下方式构造的数组：对于每个 1≤i≤N$$$1 \leq i \leq N$$$，令 bi=ai xor 1$$$b_i = a_i \text{ xor } 1$$$，其中 xor 表示按位异或运算。令 inv(A)$$$inv(A)$$$ 表示数组 A$$$A$$$ 的逆序对数量，令 inv(B)$$$inv(B)$$$ 表示数组 B$$$B$$$ 的逆序对数量(逆序对的数量是满足 i<j$$$i \lt j$$$ 且 ai>aj$$$a_i  \gt  a_j$$$ 的数对 (i,j)$$$(i,j)$$$ 的数量)。Danny 记得 inv(B)$$$inv(B)$$$ 与 inv(A)$$$inv(A)$$$ 之差。换句话说，Danny 记得一个整数 D$$$D$$$，其中 D=inv(B)−inv(A)$$$D = inv(B) - inv(A)$$$。
第三，他还记得，对于所有 0≤x≤N−1$$$0 \leq x \leq N-1$$$，x$$$x$$$ 与 x xor 1$$$x \text{ xor } 1$$$ 在数组 A 中都不相邻。
你能帮助 Danny 找出满足所有这些条件的数组 A 的可能数量吗？

input.ai: 输入的第一行也是唯一一行包含两个整数 N$$$N$$$ 和 D$$$D$$$(1≤N≤105，0≤|D|≤1018$$$1 \leq N \leq 10^5, 0 \leq |D| \leq 10^{18}$$$)。

output.ai: 一个整数：满足条件的数组数量。
由于答案可能非常大，请输出答案对 998244353$$$998244353$$$ 取模的结果。
